description: CronWatch is an open-source library for monitoring cron jobs and scheduled work inside your own application. It records runs in your own database and can alert when jobs are missed, fail, get stuck, run slowly, or exceed budgets.
summary: CronWatch exposes no hosted public API on cronwatch.dev; its developer integration surface is a local stdio MCP server plus a self-hosted JSON API/dashboard mounted inside your own app and secured with a shared bearer token or cron secret.
